_about: Public-domain John Caird (1820-1898, Church of Scotland, Principal of Glasgow University) for the Word Hoard: 7 books from Internet Archive scans, 1856-1899: Religion in Common Life (the Crathie sermon, 1856 American printing), Sermons (1858), An Introduction to the Philosophy of Religion (1880), Mind and Matter (1888), University Sermons (1898) and The Fundamental Ideas of Christianity (Gifford Lectures, two volumes, 1899, posthumous, with a memoir by his brother Edward Caird). Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 21 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
